preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(t, int) and 1 <= t <= 20000 for t in [int(stdin.split()[0])])
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 20000) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(test_case) == 2 for test_case in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Each test case consists of exactly two lines: the first line is n (3 ≤ n ≤ 200000), and the second line contains n integers a_i (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9).

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 3 <= n <= 200000 for n in [int(test_case[0]) for test_case in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer where 3 ≤ n ≤ 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n and all(isinstance(ai, int) and 1 <= ai <= 10**9 for ai in a) for n, a in [[int(test_case[0]), list(map(int, test_case[1:]))] for test_case in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains exactly n integers a_i where 1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines) == t for t, output_lines in [(int(stdin.split()[0]), [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()])])
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of test cases t.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(score, int) and score >= 0 for score in [int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()])
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer representing the maximum possible final score for the corresponding test case.

postconditions.expression: all(score == max_possible_score(a) for score, a in zip([int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()], [list(map(int, test_case[1:])) for test_case in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if line.strip()]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output score is the maximum possible final score achievable by optimally distributing bricks into 3 non-empty bags, where Bu Dengklek minimizes |w1 - w2| + |w2 - w3| by selecting one brick from each bag.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= score <= max_diff(a) for score, a in zip([int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()], [list(map(int, test_case[1:])) for test_case in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if line.strip()]))
postconditions.description: The score for each test case is bounded between 0 and the maximum possible difference between any two bricks in the input (max_diff(a) = max(a) - min(a)).
